title: Saxophrenia
identity: Saxophrenia is Hartley’s 1977 concerto for alto saxophone and wind band, dedicated to Ted Hegvik. The CDMC/Wind Music catalog in Guebwiller records the Molenaar/Dorn editions and 19-page full score.

evidence.claim: Institutional catalog confirms title, alto saxophone and wind band, 1977, Molenaar and Dorn publishers, 19-page full score, dedication, and classifies soloist level 5 and band difficulty 3.
Estate catalog lists Saxophrenia as an alto saxophone work with band or piano, 2:30, Dorn, no. 124.
evidence.source_name: Walter S. Hartley estate, saxophone works catalog

evidence.claim: The Wind Music legal notice identifies the site editor as Conseil départemental pour la Musique et la Culture (CDMC), at Guebwiller.

review_focus: Inference: a concerto format and separately reported soloist/band ratings make solo projection and ensemble balance useful review questions; notation not inspected.
collection_flag: Documented concerto for alto saxophone and band; the library catalog's level labels are not SaxoBrain levels.
gaps: No score or performance recording inspected.
